# Algo Sensei DSA tutor (Karan Bansal)

A data structures and algorithms mentor for LeetCode practice and interview prep.

- Source: https://github.com/karanb192/algo-sensei
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/karanb192/algo-sensei/main/SKILL.md
- Author: Karan Bansal
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/algo-sensei-dsa-tutor-karan-bansal-52cac2aa

Claude picks a mode from how you ask: tutoring a concept, giving progressive hints without spoiling the answer, reviewing your solution and its complexity, running a mock interview, or mapping a problem to a known pattern. It leans on questions rather than handing over answers, and supports several programming languages. Supporting files include pattern guides, solution templates and reference material.

**Try asking:**
- "Give me a hint for Two Sum, but don't tell me the answer"
- "Review my sliding window solution and its time complexity"
- "Run a 30-minute mock interview on graph problems"
